message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occur in Canada in 2023** (i.e., a statutory holiday that falls on a Monday or Friday, or a holiday that falls on a weekend and is observed on the nearest weekday).  
*Dates are shown in the format YYYY‑MM‑DD.  The “Long‑Weekend” column lists the full stretch of days that make up the three‑day break (including the weekend).*

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Dates | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|--------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | 2023‑01‑01 | Sunday | 2023‑01‑01 – 2023‑01‑02 | Observed on Monday Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | 2023‑02‑20 | Monday | 2023‑02‑18 – 2023‑02‑20 | Creates a 3‑day break |
| Good Friday | 2023‑04‑07 | Friday | 2023‑04‑07 – 2023‑04‑09 | Friday holiday → weekend |
| Victoria Day | 2023‑05‑22 | Monday | 2023‑05‑20 – 2023‑05‑22 | 3‑day break |
| Canada Day | 2023‑07‑01 | Saturday | 2023‑06‑30 – 2023‑07‑02 | Holiday on Saturday → weekend |
| Labour Day | 2023‑09‑04 | Monday | 2023‑09‑02 – 2023‑09‑04 | 3‑day break |
| Thanksgiving | 2023‑10‑09 | Monday | 2023‑10‑07 – 2023‑10‑09 | 3‑day break |
| Remembrance Day | 2023‑11‑11 | Monday | 2023‑11‑09 – 2023‑11‑11 | 3‑day break |
| Christmas Day | 2023‑12‑25 | Monday | 2023‑12‑23 – 2023‑12‑25 | 3‑day break |
| Boxing Day | 2023‑12‑26 | Tuesday | – | No long‑weekend (holiday on Tuesday only) |

### Quick‑look summary

- **January**: New Year’s Day (Jan 1–2)
- **February**: Family Day (Feb 18–20)
- **April**: Good Friday (Apr 7–9)
- **May**: Victoria Day (May 20–22)
- **June/July**: Canada Day (Jun 30–Jul 2)
- **September**: Labour Day (Sep 2–4)
- **October**: Thanksgiving (Oct 7–9)
- **November**: Remembrance Day (Nov 9–11)
- **December**: Christmas Day (Dec 23–25)

> **Tip for your app** – If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Civic Holiday in Ontario, etc.), you’ll need to add those separately. The table above covers the federal holidays that generate long weekends across the country in 2023.
